editorial_checks: A deliberately shorter closing interlude with two sections, complete Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and independently written English. The eight existing full cases retain their stronger length requirements and all previous prose remains unchanged.

The complaint's early three-mile and later two-mile versions, two-year post-employment period, more-than-ten-per-cent revenue test and any-location nationwide scope are kept distinct. The complaint is not treated as findings after a full trial.

Corporate-owned shops, the franchisor's model forms and franchisees are distinguished. The official settlement announcement's request to Illinois franchisees to rescind is not expanded into a verified nationwide act by every franchisee.

The company's response is attributed to contemporary Associated Press reporting, not described as an independently obtained original corporate statement or proof of the absence of all effects. Possible uncertainty and chilling mechanisms are not invented employee experiences or measured losses.

Alleged discontinuance, removal of old materials, rescission, intention not to enforce and notice are distinguished. The official settlement announcement does not establish subsequent completion of every obligation.
The $100,000 educational and outreach purpose is not misreported as employee compensation. The archived announcement's March 2023 print header is not its December 2016 publication date.
The essay stops at the Illinois 2016 settlement announcement, does not summarize current noncompete law, and does not conflate employee noncompetes with separate franchise no-poach disputes.

The original complaint and official archived announcement were downloaded; relevant complaint pages and the full announcement were read, with complaint page 6 and announcement page 1 also rendered and visually checked. The full consent decree was not obtained or claimed as exhaustively read.

The landing keeps the eight full case cards intact and adds a separate full-width closing interlude. First-group completion does not close the ongoing shelf. Companion links return to PetSmart and the introduction.
